title: Community and Amateur Sports Club newsletter 5 — September 2026
text:
HMRC publishes the Community and Amateur Sports Clubs ( CASCs ) newsletters to update stakeholders on the latest news and changes. 

 This newsletter has articles on: 

 • a new HMRC video highlighting how Gift Aid works

 • guidance reviews

 • enhancements to the Claim Gift Aid online service

 • updates to HMRC internal systems
